Structure: npcs[npc id] = conditions in order, the first whose `when` holds is played (a last entry without `when` is the fallback). `when` = {flags: [all must be set], not: [none may be set]}. A dialogue sets its `set` flags when it ends (finished or skipped). A line may override `speaker` and `portrait`.

lines.text: Totoy? Is that the beacon key? Let me see it.
Broken, but it still hums. Five beacons are dark, and one glows weakly.
The forest beacon is the nearest. Talk to Tovan and Edda first, then follow the east road.
The east road leads to the forest. Take your time, but do not wait too long.
I will mark the map when you come back.
Edda sent you after the Thornback Stag? She trusts you.
Light both lanterns to open the root gate. The glade lies beyond it.
A Black Katana. Worn, but it keeps its edge.
Dash with Space. Practice on the post by the forge before you meet anything real.
Gold attacks can be parried. Red ones you dodge. Remember that.
Swing at the post until the dash feels like breathing.
Come back with something strange and I will tell you what it is.
So the key came home. Sit, Totoy. I have something to teach you.
A monster's power is a fragment. You can bind it without destroying what remains of it.
Open the character menu with Tab and equip an Aspect.
The Thornback Stag in the forest is calm enough to bind. Find it.
The Stag guards the glade past the root gate. Be gentle with it if you can.
Tab opens the character menu. Check your Aspects before you go.
The Night of Returning Lights was never quiet before. Now it is.
The shrine remembers every song. Maybe you will remember too.
Are you the one with the broken key?
I saw a light in the forest last night. It was not a lantern.
These crates are for the beacon hill. If the beacon ever lights again.
Mind the east road. Mosslings have been creeping out of the forest.
